name: db-landing-service
command: 전체 빌드 실행법(오른쪽만 치면됨) 암호화 한큐에 끝. 뒤졌다 → npm run build

scripts.build:css: echo [CSS] common-nude.css → common.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/common.css css/common-nude.css && echo [CSS] brand-nude.css → brand.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/brand.css css/brand-nude.css && echo [CSS] typography-nude.css → typography.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/typography.css css/typography-nude.css && echo [CSS] premium-nude.css → premium.css && cleancss -O2 -o css/premium.css css/premium-nude.css
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run obfuscate:core && npm run build:html
